iran_nuclear.name: IRAN NUCLEAR
iran_nuclear.notes: IAEA/Board pressure is rising. Reuters reports a U.S. draft resolution demanding Iran account for damaged sites and uranium stocks, while Iran warns it will respond to any watchdog action. Agency access and safeguards verification remain impaired; no verified higher enrichment jump surfaced in this scan.

iran_conventional.name: IRAN WAR / GULF
iran_conventional.notes: Iran/Israel/Gulf risk remains near maximum. Reuters reports renewed Iran-Israel exchanges, Tehran blaming Washington, extreme suspicion in indirect contacts, continued Hormuz disruption, and Houthi Red Sea shipping threats that would hit the main bypass route for Gulf energy exports.

israel_lebanon.name: ISRAEL-LEBANON
israel_lebanon.notes: Lebanon is now a core trigger point for the wider Iran war. Al Jazeera reports Lebanon became the breaking point for the ceasefire after Israeli action around Beirut and Iran-linked retaliation; earlier truce channels remain present but not controlling events.

turkey.name: TURKEY REGIONAL
turkey.notes: Turkey remains indirectly exposed through Gaza mediation, Syria/Iraq and Gulf spillover, but the scan found no fresh Turkish weapons trial, direct clash, or major new Turkish operation crossing signal threshold.

india.name: INDIA-PAKISTAN
india.notes: India-Pakistan remains elevated. New violence in Pakistan-administered Kashmir killed at least 11 before a rights rally, but this was not verified as a cross-border India-Pakistan military exchange. Nuclear escalation signal remains below activation threshold.

russia.name: RUSSIA-NATO
russia.notes: Russia-NATO risk rises on spillover evidence. The UN Security Council reviewed a reported Russian Geran-2 drone crash in Romania with civilian injuries, repeated Romanian airspace incidents, and NATO/EU warnings; official strategic signaling remains active.

china.name: CHINA-TAIWAN
china.notes: China-Taiwan remains elevated/low-critical through baseline posture and past drills, but this scan found no fresh blockade, live-fire surge, or direct clash in the past 24-hour source set.

north_korea.name: NORTH KOREA
north_korea.notes: North Korea remains critical on baseline capability, but the scan found no fresh verified launch or atomic-device event in the past 24 hours. Recent Reuters missile reporting is older than this window.

russia_ukraine.name: RUSSIA-UKRAINE
russia_ukraine.notes: Russia-Ukraine remains at maximum. ISW/social-indexed reporting shows continuing Ukrainian intermediate-range strikes affecting Russian logistics, while UNSC coverage documents Romania spillover, drone incursions, and nuclear-safety concern at Zaporizhzhia.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: PAKISTAN-AFGHANISTAN
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: Pakistan-Afghanistan remains critical on unresolved border-war baseline. Fresh high-grade 24h sourcing was thinner than the Iran/Gaza/Ukraine sets, but search results still reflect persistent border clash context and military posture.

sudan.name: SUDAN CIVIL WAR
sudan.notes: Sudan remains critical on baseline civil-war spillover and humanitarian risk. Fresh 24h search was dominated by older/background material rather than a newly verified escalation trigger.

israel_palestine.name: ISRAEL-PALESTINE
israel_palestine.notes: Gaza risk rises. Reuters and Al Jazeera report Israeli strikes killing civilians while Egypt hosts renewed talks; later-phase implementation remains stuck over police, withdrawal, disarmament, and governance issues.

south_sudan_abyei.name: SOUTH SUDAN / ABYEI
south_sudan_abyei.notes: South Sudan/Abyei remains elevated. UN/France statements warn Sudan spillover and South Sudan instability are degrading Abyei conditions, but no fresh 24h kinetic trigger crossed activation threshold.
